Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant, in connection with FIR/Crime No.358/2023, Date:-(Not mentioned) registered at P.S.-Nanakheda,
District-Ujjain (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 120-B/34 of the IPC.
2. Prosecution story, in brief is that the applicant Smt. Nikita Das is mother of co-accused Chanchal Das.
Present applicant Nikita Das introduced herself as a worker of State Bank of Baroda, Branch- Shir Sagar, Ujjain in loan department.

entities.text: State Bank of Baroda, Branch- Shir Sagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The present applicant and co-accused Chanchal entered into a criminal conspiracy to cheat the complainant Vikram Singh Verma.

They had falsely assured the Smt. Nikita Das vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40854109/
1 complainant to get her daughter Surbhi, a job as a cashier in the bank and both of them demanded Rs.4,00,000/- and during 01/09/2022 - 31/09/2022, they got Rs.3,50,000/- by cash and bank account, from the complainant.

entities.text: Smt. Nikita Das vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When the daughter of the complainant did not get any job in the bank then the complainant enquired about the same in the Bank of Baroda, Ujjain.
There he came to know that the present applicant does not work in the bank.
It was also discovered that she has committed similar offences against other persons.
Thereafter, the matter was reported by the complainant.
After inquiry on 08/04/2023 an FIR was lodged against the present applicant and co- accused Chanchal Das.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/ accused submits that, the applicant has not committed the offence and she has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant did not receive any amount from the applicant.
Rs.50,000/- was deposited by the complainant in the bank account of co-accused Chanchal Das.
No amount was deposited in the bank account of the present applicant.
The applicant is a lady and she is in custody since 14/07/2023.

After completion of investigation,
chargesheet has been filed.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

4. On other hand learned counsel for the non-applicant/ state as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer and submitted that a criminal case likewise this offence is also pending against the applicant before the competent court.

Some other persons named Rajesh Behediya, Ditiya Behediya on 08/05/2023, Jeetendra Yadav on 17/03/2020, Urmila on 11/07/2022 have filed written complaint against the present applicant that she has also cheated aforementioned complainant or their relatives and gained wrongfully, by stating them to provide a job.
The applicant is a habitual offender, therefore, she is not entitled for the bail.

5. Having heard learned counsels for the parties, perused the case-diary also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, in view of this court, it is not a fit case to grant bail to the applicant.
Resultantly, application for bail is rejected.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Smt. Nikita Das vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40854109/
